item.title: CVS Health spends more than $1M on TV ads to block pharmacy bill
item.description: According to federal records, CVS Health has spent around $1.3 million on television ads across Tennessee in an effort to block a bill they say would force more than 100 pharmacies to close.

item.title: Columbia Fire & Rescue halts medical calls at one facility amid infection control concerns
item.description: In a highly unusual and somewhat controversial memo, personnel with Columbia Fire & Rescue will no longer respond to medical calls at one specific health care facility in the city.

item.title: VIDEO: Officer moves Waymo after it blocks Broadway intersection
item.description: A local driver captured the moment a self-driving Waymo vehicle stopped in the middle of a busy Broadway intersection this weekend.

item.title: What is Tennessee's wildest month for weather?
item.description: We have seen snow, tornadoes, temperatures in the 80s, and temperatures in the 20s! Is March Tennessee's wildest month for weather?

item.title: Metro police searching for suspect in deadly shooting on Crossings Boulevard
item.description: Metro police are searching for the person responsible for killing a man on the side of the road last week.

item.title: Nashville Mayor Freddie O'Connell invites residents to hear Community Safety Plan initiative
item.description: He’s kicking off the initiative with a series of meetings for residents. The mayor's office is collaborating with the Metro Public Health Department to give residents more of a voice in their communities.

item.title: Tennessee businesses optimistic despite economic uncertainty, survey finds
item.description: Tennessee business leaders are heading into the middle of 2026 with continued optimism, even as tariffs and artificial intelligence (AI) reshape parts of the business landscape, according to a new University of Tennessee survey.
